unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 9 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.1 - THEME 2: CLASSROOM LIFE & LEARNING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will focus on the theme ''classroom life and learning'' by reflecting on their favourite school subjects, learning activities, study tools and innovations. They will write a personalised project in which they design their ideal classroom environment by adding their preferred subjects, activities, and tools. Students will explain why these elements make learning enjoyable or effective for them, and they will suggest improvements for their least favourite aspects. The project can be presented as a written report, a creative poster, or a short video. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''classroom life and learning with its components such as favourite school subjects, learning activities, study tools and innovations'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school may know what favourite school subjects; favourite learning activities about; favourite study tools and innovations mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''classroom life and learning'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''classroom life and learning with its components such as favourite school subjects, learning activities, study tools and innovations'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about their favourite school subjects and learning activities in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Survey Challenge Students work in groups to write five survey questions about classroom preferences. They keep their questions secret and submit them to the teacher for approval. Once approved, each group conducts the survey with classmates and organises the results. Groups then present their findings to the class by highlighting trends and insights (e.g. ''Most students enjoy debates because they are engaging while writing essays is the least favourite due to boredom''). After all presentations, the class votes for the group with the most effective questions and realistic results. During presentations, the teacher gives feedback on language use, clarity, and presentation skills. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about their favourite school subjects and learning activities in English through a matching and fill-in-the-blanks activity by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Ask and Share Preferences Students work in pairs. Students ask and answer questions in turns about their preferences on favourite school subjects and learning activities such as ''Do you like science experiments?'' or ''Which do you prefer: group discussions or silent reading?'' using responses such as ''Yes, I do!'' or ''I like group discussions better''. Next, each student presents their peer's preferences to the class, e.g. ''My friend likes science experiments and prefers group discussions''. At the end of the activity, the teacher checks the answers with the class, explains the correct options, and gives constructive feedback. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
